name: Jehoiachin
overview: Jehoiachin, also known as Jeconiah or Coniah, was the son and successor of Jehoiakim who began to reign over Judah at eighteen years old but ruled only three months before Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, besieged Jerusalem and took him captive along with his family and officials. His brief and wicked reign ended with his exile to Babylon during the eighth year of Nebuchadnezzar's rule, marking a significant moment of judgment on Judah. Despite this, Jehoiachin was later released from prison and honored, highlighting God's sovereign control even over the downfall and restoration of His people.
